info.title: Cleanuparr API
info.description:
Unofficial OpenAPI description of the Cleanuparr REST API.

Cleanuparr ships no OpenAPI document of its own: the backend (`Cleanuparr.Api`, ASP.NET Core 10) registers no Swashbuckle/`Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi` generator, and the `GET /api` redirect to `/api/swagger` is dead. This document was reconstructed by reading every `[ApiController]` class, request/response contract, persistence entity and enum in the source tree.

**Provenance**: reconstructed from Cleanuparr/Cleanuparr commit `9edc685e318457cc2707eaec539dcc5e6326fae8` (2026-08-07).

## Conventions

- Default port is `11011`. A `BASE_PATH` setting can mount the whole app under a sub-path; prefix every path below with it when set.
- JSON uses ASP.NET Core web defaults: **camelCase** property names, case-insensitive binding on input.
- Enums are serialized as **strings** using their declared C# names (e.g. `qBittorrent`, `FailedImport`, `BalancedWeighted`).
- Timestamps are `DateTimeOffset` (ISO-8601 with offset).
- Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with an extra `traceId` extension. `[ApiController]` model-state failures produce the same shape with an `errors` map.
- Secrets are masked on read with the placeholder `••••••••`. Sending that placeholder back in an update preserves the stored value.
- Two SignalR hubs exist alongside the REST API and are not described here: `/api/hubs/health` and `/api/hubs/app` (JWT via `access_token` query parameter).
- Until first-run setup completes, every `/api/*` path except `/api/auth/*` returns `403 {"error":"Setup required"}`; conversely `/api/auth/setup/*` returns `403 {"error":"Setup already completed"}` once setup is done.

## Authentication

The `Smart` policy scheme picks a handler per request:

1. `X-Api-Key` header or `apikey` query parameter → API key (found under Account Settings in the UI).
2. `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` → JWT access token from `/api/auth/login`.
3. Otherwise → trusted-network bypass, which authenticates as the admin user when `auth.disableAuthForLocalAddresses` is on and the caller's IP is local or inside `auth.trustedNetworks`.

Every endpoint requires authentication unless marked otherwise.

ApiKeyQuery.description: Same API key, passed as a query parameter for clients that cannot set headers.

QueryPage.description: 1-based page number. Values below 1 are clamped to 1.

QueryPageSize.name: pageSize
QueryPageSize.description: Rows per page. Values below 1 fall back to 50; values above 500 are clamped to 500.

QueryHours720.description: Look-back window in hours, clamped to 1..8760.

QueryIncludeDryRun.description: Include activity recorded while dry-run mode was on.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests — account lockout or OIDC flow throttling.

trustedNetworks.description: Plain IPs or CIDR ranges. Loopback and private ranges are always trusted.

oidcProviderName.description: Empty string when OIDC is not usable.

urlBase.description: Path prefix for clients such as Transmission and Deluge.

downloadDirectorySource.description: Path prefix as the client reports it. Must be set together with `downloadDirectoryTarget`.

downloadDirectoryTarget.description: Local mount path substituted for the source prefix when resolving files.

downloadId.description: Download hash as reported by the client.

EventListItem.description: Projection of an event used by the list endpoint. Most fields are only populated for the event types noted.

trackingId.description: Correlates events belonging to the same item lifecycle.

counts.description: Event type to count. Types with no activity in this bucket are omitted.

types.description: Event types present anywhere in the window, in declaration order.

byType.description: Only event types with activity are present.

FailedImportConfig.description: Failed-import striking. `maxStrikes` of 0 disables it; any other value must be at least 3.

patterns.description: At least one pattern is required when striking is on and `patternMode` is `Include`.

createdAt.description: Account creation timestamp, the anchor for "new feature" detection.

dryRun.description: Simulate destructive actions instead of performing them.

encryptionKey.description: Generated GUID; returned in the clear.

connectivityCheckUrls.description: At least one is required when the connectivity check is enabled.

HealthStats.description: Cached gauge refreshed roughly every 5 minutes; not scoped to the requested timeframe.

HealthStatus.description: Cached health of one download client.

responseTime.description: TimeSpan of the last check, serialized as `hh:mm:ss.fffffff`.

JobSchedule.description: Friendly schedule converted to a Quartz cron expression. Only a fixed set of values per unit is accepted.

JobV2Stats.description: Job runs are recorded regardless of dry-run mode.

LoggingConfig.description: File logging and archiving. A `0` means "disabled" for `rollingSizeMB` and "unlimited" for the retention fields.

archiveTimeLimitHours.description: When archiving is enabled, this and `archiveRetainedCount` cannot both be 0.

loginToken.description: Short-lived token to present at `/api/auth/login/2fa`. Set only when `requiresTwoFactor` is true.

ManualEvent.description: An event that needs the user to act.

MessageResponse.description: Ad-hoc success envelope. The property name is `message` on account/auth endpoints and `Message` on configuration endpoints — both appear verbatim in responses.

apiKey.description: At least 10 characters. Masked on read; resend the placeholder to keep it.

NotificationEventFlags.description: Which events this provider is notified about.

configuration.description: Provider-specific configuration, selected by `type`. Secrets are masked. An empty object is returned when the typed configuration row is missing.

topics.description: At least one non-blank topic is required.

OidcConfig.description: Stored OIDC settings. Returned by `GET /api/account/oidc` with `clientSecret` masked.

issuerUrl.description: Base issuer URL used for `.well-known/openid-configuration` discovery. Must be HTTPS unless it points at localhost.

authorizedSubject.description: The single `sub` allowed to sign in. Written only by the link callback.

redirectUrl.description: Optional external base URL for callbacks; auto-detected from the request when empty.

exclusiveMode.description: Disables password and Plex sign-in. Requires `enabled`.

code.description: One-time code handed to the SPA by `/api/auth/oidc/callback`.

scanDirectories.description: At least one is required when enabled.

orphanedDirectory.description: Where orphaned entries are moved. Must not overlap any scan directory, any other client's scan or orphaned directory, or another client's download directory target.

excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns exempt from orphan detection.

purgeAfterHours.description: Permanently delete moved entries after this many hours. Null keeps them forever.

authUrl.description: plex.tv URL to send the user to.

completed.description: False while the user has not authorised the PIN yet — poll again.

tokens.description: Issued by the login flow only; the setup flow leaves this null.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Every error response carries a `traceId` extension tied to the current activity; rate-limit errors add `retryAfterSeconds`, and model-state failures add an `errors` map.

devices.description: Device names: letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only.

sound.description: Built-in Pushover sound name (`pushover`, `bike`, `siren`, `none`, …) or a custom one.

retry.description: Required for `Emergency` priority; at least 30 seconds.

expire.description: Required for `Emergency` priority; at most 10800 seconds.

useAdvancedScheduling.description: Use `cronExpression` verbatim instead of deriving it from the friendly schedule.

downloadingMetadataMaxStrikes.description: 0 disables; any other value must be at least 3.

minCompletionPercentage.description: Exclusive lower bound unless it is 0.

RemovalsV2Stats.description: Malware removals are the `AllFilesBlocked` + `AtLeastOneFileBlocked` entries of `byReason`.

orderedIds.description: Every rule of the client, highest priority first. Duplicates, unknown ids or a partial list are rejected.

itemTitle.description: `Unknown` when the event carried no title.

SeedingRuleEntity.description: Raw persisted seeding rule, as returned by create and update. The concrete entity depends on the client type: qBittorrent rules carry `tagsAny`/`tagsAll`/`minSeeders`/`maxInactiveDays`, Transmission rules carry tags and `minSeeders`, Deluge and µTorrent rules carry `minSeeders` only, rTorrent rules carry neither.

trackerPatterns.description: Tracker domain suffixes, case-insensitive. Empty matches any tracker.

tagsAny.description: Accepted for every client but silently ignored for Deluge, rTorrent and µTorrent.

tagsAll.description: Accepted for every client but silently ignored for Deluge, rTorrent and µTorrent.

priority.description: Auto-assigned when omitted. Ignored on update.

maxRatio.description: -1 disables. Either `maxRatio` or `maxSeedTime` must be non-negative.

minSeedTime.description: Hours to seed before removal once the ratio is met.

maxSeedTime.description: Hours before removal regardless of ratio. -1 disables.

minSeeders.description: Ignored for rTorrent, which reports no seeder count.

SeedingRuleResponse.description: Client-agnostic view of a seeding rule. Fields unsupported by the owning client are empty or null.

searchEnabled.description: Master switch for reactive and proactive searching.

arrInstanceEnabled.description: Whether the underlying *arr instance itself is enabled.

minSpeed.description: Byte-size string per second (e.g. `1MB`). Empty disables the speed check.

ignoreAboveSize.description: Byte-size string; torrents larger than this are skipped.

name.description: Must be unique among slow rules.

maxCompletionPercentage.description: Required in practice: the DTO has no default, so omitting it binds 0 and fails validation.

minimumProgress.description: Byte-size string (e.g. `10MB`); progress below this counts as stalled.

Rotate the TOTP secret and recovery codes

post.description: Invalidates the previous key immediately (32 random bytes, lower-case hex).

post.summary: Record features the user has seen
post.description: Idempotent. Unknown ids are stamped with the current time, already-seen ids keep their original timestamp. Ids longer than 64 characters are ignored; more than 100 ids per request is a 400.

get.description: `clientSecret` is returned masked.

put.description: `authorizedSubject` is never set here — it is written only by the link callback. Changing `issuerUrl` clears the discovery cache.

post.summary: Begin linking an OIDC identity to this account

delete.description: Clears `authorizedSubject` and turns off exclusive mode.

get.description: Anonymous by necessity — the identity provider redirects the browser here without a bearer token. The flow is bound to the user who started it. Redirects to `{basePath}/settings/account?oidc_link=success` or `...?oidc_link_error=failed`.

put.description: Revokes every active refresh token. Rejected while OIDC exclusive mode is on.

post.summary: Request a Plex PIN to link an account
Poll the Plex PIN and store the linked account
Log in with username and password
post.description: When 2FA is enabled the response carries `requiresTwoFactor: true` plus a short-lived `loginToken` to be exchanged at `/api/auth/login/2fa`; otherwise tokens are issued directly. Failed attempts extend a lockout of `failedAttempts * 2` seconds, surfaced as a `retryAfterSeconds` problem extension (or a 429 once the lockout is active). Disabled entirely while OIDC exclusive mode is on.

post.summary: Complete login with a TOTP or recovery code
Request a Plex PIN for sign-in
Poll the Plex PIN and sign in
post.description: Issues tokens once the PIN is authorised and the Plex account matches the linked one. 2FA is not required for Plex sign-in.

post.summary: Revoke a refresh token
post.description: Idempotent: unknown or already-revoked tokens still return 200.

get.description: Always redirects back into the SPA. On success the location is `{basePath}/auth/oidc/callback?code=<one-time-code>`; that code is exchanged for tokens at `/api/auth/oidc/exchange`. Tokens are never placed in the URL. Failures redirect to `{basePath}/auth/login?oidc_error=...`.

post.description: Stores the secret against the account but leaves 2FA disabled until verified. Regenerating replaces any previously issued recovery codes.

200.description: TOTP secret, otpauth URI and recovery codes

put.description: Only the job-level settings; per-client settings live on their own endpoints.
